en.titre:
HOW TO BECOME
A MAN PEOPLE
RESPECT.

en.texte: Think before you react. The calmest man in the room is the one people listen to.
Do what you said you'd do, even the small things. That's how trust is built.
Hard things done every week build quiet confidence. A running coach app like Atala has your week of runs ready.
Shower, deodorant, clean clothes. Looking after yourself is the first form of respect.
Dim the lights an hour before sleep. A rested man makes better calls.
